title: The Painting Portal
description: A dimly lit, decaying room with a large wooden desk, vintage radio, lit desk lamp, and coffee cup. Rain pours through a broken skylight onto the wet floor, while a man in a suit stands beside an enormous golden-framed painting depicting an endless red-lit hallway with multiple doors.
prompt: A decaying concrete room with rain pouring through a broken skylight, wet reflective floor, old wooden desk with lit brass lamp, vintage radio, paper coffee cup and coiled rope. A huge golden frame contains a surreal painting of an endless hallway bathed in red light with repeating doors receding into darkness. A man in a dark suit stands touching the frame, moody cinematic lighting, atmospheric and surreal
